entries.632a8d5668ddd0a1: Since its founding in 1937 it has specialized in diamond tools, and it develops products in a single segment. The Technology Development Center, composed of production technology departments at domestic plants, conducts research and development in cooperation with the sales division, and is developing new products for each industry, including CMP conditioners, PCD multi-flute end mills and grinding stones for superfinishing bearing raceway surfaces. Diamond tools are said to have a longer service life and higher efficiency than other tools, which is said to lead to reduced environmental impact at manufacturing sites.
